description: Convenience wrapper agents call right before paying. Returns `should_pay: true` ONLY when ARI returned an explicit green/fair verdict against a usable FMV baseline. Every other outcome · amber, red, insufficient_data, missing FMV baseline, or any verdict label this client cannot interpret · returns `should_pay: false` (fail-closed). The companion `verdict` and `reason` fields explain why so the agent can decide whether to fall back to its own policy.

unit.description: Unit code (e.g. tokens, calls, seconds). Required so the quote is compared against the correct unit's FMV band.

name: refuse_if_overpriced
title: Decide whether to pay a quote
